## A smart organizer for your Luma canvas

The Luma agent now understands what's on your board and organizes it the way your team works.

## Your Luma canvas, organized.

Big brand projects outgrow their boards, and finding assets starts to take longer than making the next one. The new Luma agent smart organization capability changes that. Ask the agent to organize a board, a frame or a selection, and it groups and labels the work by what belongs together, so your team keeps making on the board that holds the project.

## Shape the organization of your board

File names and dates say nothing about the work. The agent reads what is in each asset, what it was made from, and what sits around it. It can tell a reference photo from a generated variation, follow which versions came from which image, and connect assets to the brief. A board can now be grouped by product, concept, campaign, state of production, or channel.

## What the organizer does

The agent understands how your assets relate, not just how many you have, and can organize:

• Bigger projects. It works through large boards section by section, up to 10,000 assets.

• Everyday cleanup. Turn a busy board into named sections or group a selection or a frame and leave the rest of the board alone.

• Your preferences. Give it a rule, like "sort by background color, labeled to match" or "group by product and campaign concept."

• Offer, then accept. As new work lands, the agent can offer to group it. Nothing moves until you say yes. Reverse any organizing run without losing the edits you made after it.

## You shape what comes next

The agent never rearranges your board on its own. It stays inside the area you chose, and when it finishes, the agent tells you what changed. Try it now: Open a board in Luma and ask the agent to "organize this board." To tidy just part of it, select a frame or a few assets first and ask the agent to organize the selection.

أعلنت Luma عن ميزة جديدة تتيح لوكيلها الذكي تنظيم مساحة العمل بطلب بسيط.

• يمكن الطلب من وكيل Luma تنظيم لوحة كاملة أو إطار أو تحديد معيّن.
• يقوم الوكيل بتجميع العناصر ووسمها.
• يدعم التعامل مع ما يصل إلى 10,000 أصل.

توفّر الميزة الوقت على فرق العمل الإبداعية التي تدير أعدادًا كبيرة من الملفات.
